notes.title: PHILGOOD 0.1.3 MAJOR UPDATE with a starting price
notes.content:
Hey!
Hello everyone, 

Finally, the big major PhilGood 0.1.3 build is now up. 

This update is significant because it will be accompanied by a starting price of [b]9,99 $[/b] still in Early Access.
This new paid version will be effective on Tuesday [b]13 October 2020[/b] and there will be no more free version from this date.
The price to go up when the game hits the final release V 1.0.

Also significant because this update 0.1.3 increases the playing time by about 50% but it also brings important improvements:

• The possibility to choose keyboard commands in the options 
  (via the key "esc" -> "options" -> "controls").
• The complete empire 1 (or "golden age"). 
• New card from empire 1.
• 3 infinity bars.
• Improved guide scheme in the 1st water leakage puzzle and automatic closing.
• Improved understanding of the "Lumen" puzzles: in 2 steps and 
  locking of the correct answer in green colour.  
• Permanent display of the amount of water in the tank. 
• 4 water leakage puzzles.
• 3 "Lumen" puzzles. 
• A slower death because of Cardio

Once again, thank you for your support, and I hope that if you encounter issues, you report them on steam forums, [url=https://twitter.com/philgoodgame]twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/Philgoodgame-291887971697450/?view_public_for=291887971697450]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.philgoodgame.com]philgoodgame[/url] or [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCLiWaKabi1XdMWByjwpjCuw]Youtube[/url].

Anyways, folks, I hope you like this update, and i see you guys on the forums!

Have fun,
Phil Bod

notes.title: PhilGood arrives on Steam Early Access this August!
notes.content:
[b]Fight every enemy, solve every riddle in order to overcome obstacles and get a little closer to the “truth”.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35480439/b5f01a49c92ad8af0a50d8d6adf93fc4106fde6d.png[/img]

Hello Everyone!

I am pleased to announce that the PhilGood page is now available!

The game will be playable in free version and early access from August 5.
But (for the most impatient) you can already test it by downloading it from  
http://www.philgoodgame.com/#download  
or on 
https://bodgamestudio.itch.io/philgood

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35480439/31e446fba4b320b5f2f68d8c35dae8138c341dcd.png[/img]

If you would like to support PhilGood in additional ways, tell your friends, tell your favorite youtubers and post about it on social media. Every bit of support pushes the game.

Finally, I would like to thank all those who are and will be with me on this journey to make PhilGood an amazing game!

Have fun with PhilGood!

Phil Bod
